directory.title: The Radical Pages
directory.subtitle: Open publishing infrastructure
directory.intro: An open directory of publishers, distributors, ordering systems and publishing infrastructure. Use the pilot to test category browsing, full-directory search, filters, table and list views, and individual entry pages.
directory.pilot_notice: Expanded pilot: this content is simplified interface-testing data and should not yet be treated as a verified public directory.

types.name: Ordering systems
types.description: Systems and services used by booksellers and institutions to search for and order books.

types.name: Platforms and distributors
types.description: Wholesalers, distributors and platforms that connect publishers, booksellers and readers.

types.name: Independent publishers
types.description: Independent, radical and specialist publishers working outside the largest corporate groups.

types.name: University publishers
types.description: University presses and academic publishers associated with higher-education institutions.

types.name: Conglomerates and multinational corporations
types.description: Large publishing groups and multinational media corporations with multiple divisions and imprints.

entries.name: PubEasy
entries.summary: A web-based service for checking book information and placing trade orders.
entries.overview: This pilot record demonstrates an ordering-system profile. It is included to test category pages, search, filtering and external links.
entries.notes: Pilot wording only; verify all operational details before publication.

entries.name: BatchLine
entries.summary: A sample UK ordering and bibliographic-data entry for interface testing.
entries.overview: The record exists primarily to ensure the ordering-systems archive contains multiple results and can be filtered by country and speciality.

entries.name: Gardners
entries.summary: A UK book wholesaler and distributor represented here with simplified pilot data.
entries.overview: This record tests platform and distributor pages, country filtering and relationships to publishers and ordering systems.
entries.notes: Pilot wording only; commercial terms are not represented.

entries.name: Ingram Content Group
entries.summary: A large publishing-services and distribution organisation used here as pilot data.
entries.overview: The entry demonstrates searching by distribution, international scope and related organisations.

entries.name: Bookshop.org
entries.summary: An online bookselling platform included to test platform classification and topic search.
entries.overview: This simplified record helps test relationships between sales platforms, independent bookshops and publishers.

entries.name: Freedom Press
entries.summary: An anarchist publisher, bookshop and newspaper based in London.
entries.overview: This expanded pilot profile demonstrates the individual-entry layout, related records, specialities and distribution information.
entries.notes: Pilot wording only; the eventual directory record should be researched and cited.

entries.name: AK Press
entries.summary: A worker-run publisher and distributor specialising in anarchist and radical literature.
entries.overview: This pilot record is structured to test searches for anarchism, labour and political theory, as well as related-entry links.

entries.name: PM Press
entries.summary: An independent publisher of radical books and periodicals.
entries.overview: The record provides another anarchism-related result so live suggestions and filtered results can be evaluated.

entries.name: Pluto Press
entries.summary: An independent publisher represented with simplified political and social-science pilot data.
entries.overview: This entry helps test UK filtering and searches for politics, economics and social movements.

entries.name: Verso Books
entries.summary: An independent publisher included to test political-theory and international-distribution searches.
entries.overview: The profile is deliberately concise and exists to exercise search ranking, list/table switching and relations.

entries.name: Duke University Press
entries.summary: A university press included as sample academic-publishing data.
entries.overview: This record tests the university-publisher category and searches for cultural studies and political theory.

entries.name: Manchester University Press
entries.summary: A UK university press included to test academic-publisher pages and UK filters.
entries.overview: The entry demonstrates how university presses appear alongside other organisation types without requiring a separate post type.

entries.name: Penguin Random House
entries.summary: A large international publishing group included to test the conglomerate category.
entries.overview: This simplified entry tests broad corporate categories, international location filtering and relationship panels.
entries.notes: Pilot wording only; divisions, ownership and imprints are intentionally omitted.

entries.name: Hachette Livre
entries.summary: A multinational publishing group represented with simplified pilot information.
entries.overview: The record exists to test conglomerate browsing and relationships among large publishing groups.

entries.name: HarperCollins
entries.summary: A large publishing company included to complete the conglomerate pilot set.
entries.overview: This record is deliberately brief and exists to test pagination, table rows and related entries.
